lede: The biggest thing on the calendar this week is Carhenge — the proposed redevelopment at 700 W. Pacific Ave gets two separate hearings on Tuesday, September 30: a special HARC session reviewing preliminary architecture for multiple building clusters, and a Town Council appeal hearing on the lot subdivision that a law firm challenged after P&Z approved it in July. Meanwhile, the Gondola Leadership Committee takes up a consequential choice Monday between federal funding and local control for gondola delivery, and the County commissioners dig into a proposed Employee Housing Impact Fee Tuesday as well.

notable.stake: Council votes on federal vs. local financing path for gondola replacement.
HARC reviews three preliminary large-scale Carhenge building applications.
Council hears appeal that could reverse the approved Carhenge lot subdivision.
Commissioners discuss new Employee Housing Impact Fee for unincorporated county.
DRB considers final architecture for 15 employee apartments and 4 multifamily units.
